definitions.explanation: A live musical performance on a street or in a public outdoor area. In Japan, this is a common way for aspiring musicians to build an audience, especially in areas like Shibuya, Shinjuku, and around train stations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{路上|ろじょう}ライブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やっている→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: Someone is doing a street performance in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{路上|ろじょう}ライブ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}いた→磨く：02427_migaku⟧。
examples.english: When I was young, I honed my skills through street performances.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦バンド→バンド：05508_bando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦デビュー→デビュー：11016_debyuu⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{渋谷|しぶや}→渋谷：30632_shibuya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{路上|ろじょう}ライブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧らしい。
examples.english: Apparently, even that famous band was doing street performances in Shibuya before their debut.

notes:
USAGE:
A Japanese-English compound: ⟦{路上|ろじょう}→路上：19441_rojou⟧ (on the street) + ⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧ (live performance). The activity is ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {路上|ろじょう}ライブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to busk, to do a street performance). The performer is called a ⟦{路上|ろじょう}→路上：19441_rojou⟧ミュージシャン or ストリートミュージシャン.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {路上|ろじょう}ライブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do a street performance)
- {路上|ろじょう}ライブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to watch a street performance)
- ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{路上|ろじょう}ライブ (a street performance in front of a station)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many successful Japanese musicians started with street performances. However, some areas require permits or prohibit amplified music, and police may ask performers to move.
